objective: Qualify and repair Vulkan 1.0 contracts crossing native R3V into Radeon DRM, validate on RS482, and integrate source and packaging through reviewed merges.

integration_receipts.mesa_review_threads: All 14 PR 2183 review threads report resolved after the merged tracker source correction.

integration_receipts.retention: Three merged editing worktrees move to recoverable trash. Detached qualification worktrees and external build artifacts remain retained for the continuing DRM work.

scope: The task list records work status. Existing policy ledgers retain authority over individual kernel contracts. Normative Vulkan clause mapping remains pending; registry command presence alone establishes neither a kernel defect nor conformance.

Two configuration warnings concern redundant selectors and disabled r300 LLVM; compiler-warning searches match zero diagnostics. Review corrections require a separate exact-head qualification.

tasks.work: Run memory allocation, mapping, object lifetime, public surface, fill route, and submission tests through the built native implementation and drm-shim.
tasks.acceptance: At Mesa commit 9a8857e84ca729c44de4ec581cd901b3e341f2a6, 84 focused tests report 77 OK and 7 EXPECTEDFAIL. All 441 registered R3V tests report 395 OK, 38 EXPECTEDFAIL, 8 SKIP, and 0 FAIL. These host and DRM shim results leave target and kernel parser qualification open.

tasks.work: Commit the sanitized source-specific result bundles staged in steinmarder-r300, address the two Mesa PR 2186 review threads, and merge the exact-head qualified repairs independently of unrelated DRM work.

tasks.acceptance: Git and runtime receipts distinguish source, installed payload, and running code.

tasks.acceptance: Valid resource roles pass; inaccurate write declarations fail before scheduling, with dependency and fence publication effects tested.

tasks.work: Trace callers and exclusion around fence draining during suspend before deciding whether the documented precondition or implementation needs correction.
tasks.acceptance: A complete caller proof or tested lock correction closes the policy question.

tasks.acceptance: Reproduced failures are repaired while valid behavior and unsafe-input refusals remain tested.

tasks.acceptance: Both builds pass and steinmarder-r300 retains module identity, preflight, commands, outcomes, and hardware evidence.
